lines.en: label mikudorm45:
I knock on Miku’s door and wait for her to answer.
It’s the first instance of me coming here to spend time with her since the Christmas party, and while I should be of the mindset that maybe things might go somewhere this time-
I can’t help but worry that Makoto might somehow get involved again.
I was able to miraculously survive one topless Miku run-in with her (Albeit with a surprisingly painful slap) but I really don’t know if I’d be able to emerge from a second alive.
Considering that I haven’t heard anything from Makoto yet, though, I doubt that Miku has told her anything.
Which is good, because I have no idea how I’d react if I were to be suddenly confronted by the two of them at once regarding our respective relationships.
Oh no.
: Ah! One more second, Sensei! I’m...not done gettin' ready yet!
: What exactly are you getting ready for, Miku?
: I...can’t tell you that!
: Well, that’s not suspicious at all.
: Just...give me another minute! I made a mistake!
: What kind of mistake would-
: Just give me a friggin’ minute, okay?! Jeez!
You know, maybe I should just quietly back out of the hall and go find something else to do?
This is likely one of those times where my inner monologue mysteriously predicts what is going to happen next, and I’m not really in the mood for a confrontation right now.
Or...ever, for that matter.
Let alone one that potentially involves someone as good at slapping as Makoto.
: Okay! You can come in now, Sensei!
: Before I do, can you confirm whether or not Makoto is in there?
: Makoto? No, she’s at work right now.
Oh.
I guess...Miku wasn’t getting ready for an intervention then?
What else would she be getting ready for, though?
scene black
I open the door to greet Miku and-
scene intervention1
: Why don’t you take a seat, Sensei?
: You know, I was really hoping I wouldn’t ever have to hear those words.
: Also, Makoto is here after all. Surprise.
: You fucking liar.
: We’re here precisely because Miku isn’t a liar, Sensei.
: Or rather- that she’d prefer to not keep things hidden from her best friend, despite how desperately you may want her to.
: Why is it okay to lie to me and not to you? That doesn’t seem fair at all.
scene intervention2
: Oh, fantastic! Since we’re now on topic of what constitutes “fair,” how about you-
: Ahem.
: I believe I told Sensei to take a seat, Makoto. ‘Yer gonna ruin the innervention.
scene intervention3
: Ugh. Fine. Sensei, please sit down so we can proceed with this intervention.
: I really don’t want to.
: You’ve gotta, Sensei. You’ve got two ladies wrapped around ‘yer finger and the time’s come to untangle ‘em.
: There are a lot more than just two, Miku. Frankly, there are so many at this point that I doubt Sensei will ever be able to untangle all of them.
: Yeah, thanks for the reminder.
scene black
I take a seat in a third chair that Miku and Makoto set up on the side of the room and wonder why they went to the trouble of doing that instead of just letting me sit on the couch.
But I guess comfort is probably the least of their concerns right now, when-
: Oh, no. Don’t go getting lost in thought right now, Sensei...
scene intervention4
: I should have just stayed at home.
: This was gonna happen whether ya liked it or not, Sensei. It’s the only way we can settle matters once and for all.
: Fine. Then I pick Makoto since at least she doesn’t lie to me. Meeting adjourned.
scene intervention5
if day > 5:
: Excellent. See you in school on Monday, Sensei.
else:
: Excellent. See you in school tomorrow, Sensei.
: Wait, no! The choice ain’t supposed to be as easy as that! In fact, there ain’t supposed to be a choice at all! Neither one of us expects ya to just-
: Sensei’s clearly made his decision already, Miku. I believe the only thing left for us to do is accept it.
scene intervention6
: Well...yeah. I guess that would be the easiest thing to do. Definitely a heck of a lot easier for me. But I kinda figured we were gonna at least talk about it a little.
: I ain’t ever liked somebody before, and I don’t want all these weird feelings cloggin’ up my brain when it’s already givin’ Usain Bolt a run for his money.
: I know, I know. I was only being half serious. I’m just...not sure how to do this, though. Organizing an intervention for a love triangle is not exactly “normal.”
: You know an organized meeting is bad when even Makoto isn’t into it.
scene intervention7
: I’m doin’ my best, okay?!
: Let’s just...let Miku take charge of this. She’s proven to be quite effective at making the first move as of late.
scene intervention8
: You seem less mad at me than I expected you to be.
: Oh, don’t get me wrong. I want to be angrier with you. I just know that, in this case, Miku was the one who pounced on you.
: All you did was buy her a present she really liked.
: Granted, I’m sure there was much more that happened beforehand that ultimately culminated in this all happening, but the fault isn’t yours alone.
: Miku’s obviously had feelings for you for quite some time. Obviously not as long as I have, but it’s not as if we can ignore those feelings when they’re just as real as anyone else’s.
: So much for letting Miku take charge of the meeting.
scene intervention9
: I can’t believe you kissed her before me!
: Didn’t ya just admit I was the one who kissed him, Makoto?
: Yes, but still!
: Do you want me to kiss you right now and even the playing field?
scene intervention10
: Yes, actually. I would very much appreciate that.
: Wait, wait, wait! Hold on a sec! Nobody’s kissin’ anyone!
: Maybe not right now. But who knows what the fuck you two would do if I were to leave the room.
: Just cause I kinda attacked Sensei doesn’t mean I think I’m at the front of the race or anythin’ like that!
: I just didn’t want us keepin’ secrets from each other anymore! ‘Specially if I’ve got the green light to go ahead and try and make sense of all these butterflies!
: Green light? What are you talking about?
scene intervention11
: Did you really think I was going to stop Miku from following her heart just because it’s trailing my own?
: I’ll admit that I was hoping things would never come to this but, now that they have, what else are we supposed to do other than simply deal with them?
: Frankly, I’m more comfortable with the idea of you romantically pursuing Miku than any of the other girls.
: Not that I’d ever expect you to romantically pursue anyone when romance is the furthest thing from your mind...but still.
: So what, then? I’m free to just mess around with both of you? Because if that’s the case, this meeting could have been solved with a single text message.
scene intervention12
: Sensei...you know we’re not just tryin’ to “mess around,” right? Me and Makoto actually like like you.
: Makoto and I.
: What am I supposed to do about that, though?
: I don’t know...maybe just...consider it when we’re all doin’ stuff together?
: The whole reason I wanted to do somethin’ like this is so we wouldn’t hurt each other’s feelings in the long run.
: Both of you guys are crazy important to me, and I don’t wanna risk hidin’ anything if I think it could make stuff worse.
That’s a surprisingly mature outlook from one of the least mature girls I know.
But it’s...respectable in its own twisted sort of way.
How much exactly does Miku intend to share, though? Because there’s certainly one thing I can think of that I can’t really imagine Makoto just brushing off.
: I just feel like this is more of a thing for the two of you rather than me.
: If I’m not being forced to pick between you, I can’t imagine this meeting making any sort of impact on things to come.
scene intervention13
: It is mostly for just me and Makoto-
: Makoto and me, in this case.
: But you are Makoto.
: Oh, I get it.
: But yeah. It is mostly for us two, I guess. I just think that if everybody’s gonna be involved in this weird triangle thingy...that we should all know about it.
: And that even if none of us are tryin’ to hold the other ones back...that we’re okay with whatever happens.
: Are you really okay with whatever happens, though, Miku?
scene intervention14
: Whaddya mean?...
: Like if you decide to just go full-Makoto and ignore how I feel? Course I wouldn’t be okay with it...so maybe that ain’t the best word.
: I’d understand, though.
: I don’t really know how you make decisions and stuff, Sensei, but if I were in your shoes, I’d be tryin’ to hurt the least amount’a people possible.
: One of us is obviously gonna get hurt. Maybe even all three. But I feel like just knowin’ that is enough to make it all hurt a little less.
: I want to give you a hug, but I hardly think this is the right time.
scene intervention15
: Huggin’ your rival’s just as good as admitting defeat! We can hug when all of this is said and done.
: If things are ever said and done. Sensei here is so helpless when it comes to making decisions that, more often than not, I find myself making them for him.
: Can you do me a favor and decide that this meeting is over, then? Because if nobody has any questions-
scene intervention16
: Oh, I’ve got a question. How come ya ain’t kissed my roommate yet?
: I don’t like the bluntness with which that question was asked, but I definitely would like to know the answer to that as well.
: Just hasn’t come up yet.
: But, like...
scene intervention17
: Ain’t you two already doin’ more...adult stuff?
: You know, I kind of assumed that when you said you two share everything that you didn’t literally mean everything.
: Isn’t...goin’ straight to the major stuff like that kinda like cheating?
: Is this something we really have to discuss right now?
: Does it have somethin’ to do with how Makoto’s always surrounded by those videos? You like...doin’ her a favor to prevent her from goin’ crazy or somethin’?
scene intervention18
: Obviously n-
: Yes.
scene intervention19
: That is absolutely not why we have been doing those things!
: So if you ever find yourself going crazy as well, Miku-
scene intervention20
: Don’t listen to him. This is how he traps you into a relationship where he doesn’t have to kiss you because you’ve already skipped that step.
: Run while you still can. Don’t turn into another me.
: Two Makotos does sound like a little too much now that ya mention it...
: Why don’t ya just kiss him yourself, though? It ain’t that hard. Ya just kinda...go for it.
: Yeah, Makoto. This is all your fault and you should try and be more like Miku.
scene intervention21
: Maybe you should try and be more like Miku! I have done more than enough for you and deserve a reward every once in a while!
: She does deserve it, Sensei.
: Correct me if I’m wrong, but...aren’t you supposed to be rooting for yourself right now?
: I figured the whole “Team Makoto” thing would be over with after today and that you’d try a little harder to keep me to yourself.
scene intervention22
: Why would I try and keep ya to myself when Makoto likes you too? That ain’t fair at all.
: I don’t see any reason why I can’t stay on Team Makoto and like you. There some kinda rule against that?
: I mean...I don’t think there’s a rulebook we can consult...but that’s not normally how love triangles go...
scene intervention23
: Well, maybe it ain’t really a triangle then?
: Aren’t you kinda rootin’ for me too, Makoto?
: Uhh...
: Not really?
: I obviously don’t want to hold you back from pursuing the person you admire, but if you’re asking if I’m hoping you and Sensei get closer...absolutely not.
: Oh.
: Huh.
scene intervention24
: Guess I’m the weird one, then.
: No surprise there.
: Do you have any questions, Sensei?
: Just one. Was this really necessary?
: Probably not. But I’m sure it made Miku feel a little more comfortable and, strangely enough, I think I feel that way as well.
: Well, I don’t. This was weird and I’d prefer that we don’t ever do anything like this again in the future.
: If you honestly think you’ll be able to avoid a similar conflict in the future, you’re out of your mind.
: It’s only a matter of time until you’re having this exact conversation with every pair of friends who fall hopelessly in love or...like with you.
: All things considered, I think Miku and me handled this extremely well.
: Miku and I.
scene intervention25
: I changed my mind. You can have him.
scene black
The intervention comes to a close as Makoto needs to start getting ready for work.
It definitely feels a little later than normal for her to start heading over there, so I initially dismiss it as an excuse to give Miku and me some time alone.
But that notion is immediately quelled when Makoto says this.
: Oh, and you two are going to be walking there with me. I refuse to leave this room knowing that her shirt would immediately come off as soon as the door closes.
: That happened one time!
: I do kinda wanna walk, though. So I’ll come.
: And you, Sensei?
: Ugh, fine.
scene intervention26
: Oh, for fuck’s sake! Who keeps turning the number on our door upside down?! It’s getting very tiring!
: Do you really think it’s weird that I wanna be on Team Makoto and Team Miku? Cause I just don’t really get why.
: That’s something you’ll have to talk to Makoto about. I’m perfectly fine with it.
: I do stand to benefit the most, though, so I’m probably biased.
scene intervention27
: Why are we talking about that again?! The intervention is over and it’s time to return to reality!
: Oh, and sorry for lyin’ about Makoto not bein’ around. I figured ya would’ve ran if I told ya she was with me.
: It’s whatever. That honestly went a lot better than I was expecting.
: Yeah, nobody cried at all. And Makoto only got a tiny bit flustered when I brought up her relationship with “little” Sensei.
: Please don’t call it that, Miku.
: Please don’t talk about that at all! And definitely not in the halls!
scene black
